messages.subject: Un-standardizing covariates
parts:
Dear Andy & Richard,

I joined the webinar today (2:30am my time -I live in Borneo) but
didn't catch it all due to my spotty internet connection. I have also
looked through the Unmarked manual, and I apologize if the answer to
my question is in there and I just missed it.

Anyway, I've standardized my covariates, run my models, and generated
model-averaged predictions, but I'd like to graph the effects of each
covariate on occupancy with the covariates in their original scale,
rather than in the standardized scale. How do I "un-standardize" the
covariates?

Also, I believe you guys said that you were going to post the slides
and Q&As from the webinar. Where would I find that post?

Thanks so much in advance. I'm really excited about Unmarked!

messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Un-standardizing covariates

Dear Jaya,
 There are examples of this in both the occu() and pcount() sections of the workshop (see the R scripts associated with that).
 look at this one: 
https://sites.google.com/site/unmarkedinfo/home/webinars/2012-january/r-scripts/moduleABUN_ALFL.R?attredirects=0&d=1
 
search on "original scale"
 
regards
andy
